section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains how every good deed tips the scales for the entire world, especially on Rosh Hashanah after the shofar blast, leading to blessing and the coming of Moshiach.
section.t: And all this is accomplished through every good deed of each and every Jew,
and as the ruling
that through one mitzvah
(in thought,
and all the more so in speech and all the more so in action)
one tips the entire world to the scale of merit.
For this ruling applies throughout the entire year.
And all the more so on Rosh Hashanah, when it is not at all possible to say that the world is balanced, G‑d forbid,
since already on the eve of Rosh Hashanah we know with absolute certainty that they will be vindicated in judgment,
and all the more so on Rosh Hashanah itself,
and especially after the shofar blast,
for any year that is impoverished at its beginning becomes enriched at its end,
and it is known that "impoverished at its beginning" refers to
(before)
the shofar blast, because the shofar is the aspect of straits and from
"from the straits I called upon Yah,"
and immediately afterward it becomes enriched,
"answer me"
"in the broad expanse of Yah,"
"by the light of Your countenance they shall walk,"
for a good writing and sealing
in the revealed and manifest good in all that is needed,
and all the more so in the essential matter
—the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu speedily in our days, immediately,
literally.
